# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of ~150 short call snippets is overwhelmingly **internal operations chatter** — loading/unloading disputes, driver/location directions, GPS/route guidance to "Manali Andarkuppam" factory, e-way bill/GST maintenance worries, bill-copy and payment-collection follow-ups, Ola/rapido-style vehicle-booking cancellations, and Diwali-gift-distribution logistics for dealers. Only a **minority of calls are genuine sales conversations** (new enquiries, rate negotiations, quantity/stock checks, dealer price-matching against competitors). This KB is built strictly from those genuine sales exchanges. Given how thin the real sales content is relative to the ops noise, conclusions below should be read as **directionally useful, not exhaustive** — there is no evidence of structured scripts, CRM discipline, or formal objection training; staff improvise rate quotes from memory and escalate confirmation to "Sir"/"MD" before closing.

The company is **Crayon Roofing & Structures**, based in Manali (near Andarkuppam/CPCL), Chennai — confirmed directly in-call: *"Sir, company name Crayon Roofing and Structures"* and *"Sir JSW metal roofing sheet நம்ம பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம், Supply பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம் sir. Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது"* [We're a JSW metal roofing sheet supplier only — we don't do fixing/fabrication work]. They are a **JSW distributor** supplying raw sheet/coil + allied hardware to dealers, fabricators and a few end-customers — not a turnkey roofing contractor.

## Products & brand ladder

From actual quotes, three clear tiers of JSW metal roofing sheet emerged:

1. **JSW Color On Plus** — the premium line, AZ150 coating, full color range (sky blue, off white, grey, blue, red, **brick red**). *"brick red வேற எதுலுமே இருக்காது color on-ல மட்டும் தான் இருக்கு brick red"* [brick red is available only in Color On, nowhere else]. Thicknesses sold: 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.60mm.
2. **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — mid/entry tier, AZ70 coating, **only sky blue and off white/half white** colors (no grey, no brick red, no green stock). *"grey stock எப்பவுமே வைக்கிறது இல்லை ஏன்னா அது Pragathi-ல sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்"* [we never stock grey because Pragathi only comes in sky blue/off white]. For large (10-ton) grey orders they source externally and relabel.
3. **JSW Indradhanush** — the cheapest/thinnest line (0.40–0.45mm, AZ70), again sky blue/half white only.
4. **Silver On / Silver On Plus** — bare galvanized (AZ150), 0.40/0.47mm, sold by kg as "plain sheet."

Other SKUs mentioned in real sales calls:
- **Polycarbonate sheets** (2mm, various lengths — 12.5 ft sample requests)
- **Decking sheets** (0.8mm, 1mm, 1.2mm — used for transformer platforms, floor decking)
- **Puff roof panel** (50mm — ₹1600+GST per sq. meter, one WhatsApp quote)
- **Tata-brand screws** — self-tapping, multiple lengths (1", 1.5", 2", 2.5", 3", 100mm, 120mm, 130mm), with full-thread vs double-thread (DT/FT) stock variations, and profile/stitch screws
- **Tata welding rods / electrodes** (2.5mm commonly ordered)
- **Cutting & grinding wheels** (4-inch)
- **Flashing accessories** — L-flash, ridge/flashing sold per running meter (standard length 2.5m)

The company does **not** fabricate sheds, fixing, or UPVC sheets — multiple calls explicitly clarify this to confused buyers.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- JSW Color On Plus 0.47mm AZ150: **₹435–445 + GST per sq. meter** (quoted variously as 430, 435, 445, 465, 475 depending on buyer/date — clearly date- and negotiation-sensitive)
- JSW Color On Plus 0.50mm (AZ150, "15 years warranty"): **₹475 + GST/sq. meter**
- JSW Color On Plus 0.60mm AZ150: **₹560 + GST/sq. meter**
- Pragathi Plus 0.40mm: **₹105 + GST/kg**
- Pragathi/Silver On Plus 0.47mm AZ150: **₹101 + GST/kg**
- JSW Indradhanush 0.45mm AZ70: **₹375 + GST/sq. meter**; also quoted ₹370+tax/sq.ft and ₹335+tax (0.40mm) in separate calls
- Cash-and-carry plain-coil rate: **₹100/kg**; credit rate **₹101/kg** ("cash and carry-க்கு ₹100-ன்னா credit-க்கு ₹1 extra") — a consistent ₹1/kg credit premium
- Competitor/market pressure rate cited repeatedly: **₹98–98.50/kg** (used by sales reps to request management price-matching)
- Self-tapping screw 130mm (Tata): **₹14 + GST per screw**
- Welding rod 2.5mm: **₹332–336 including GST**; one "offer price" of **₹270 + GST**
- 70 GSM vs 150 GSM coating price difference: **₹405+GST vs ₹435+GST** (both square-meter basis) — quality is "level coating," not thickness
- Terms observed: **50% advance** required to start production on bulk/custom orders ("50% advance இருக்கணும் sir"); Monday/after-lunch delivery
